LongDescription: Growth in long term operating assets
Test in OP: port sort but no LS FF3 adjusted
Notes: Long port has t=3.2 by itself, so it's a judgment call.
Detailed Definition: Annual growth in net operating assets, minus accruals. Net operating assets are (rect + invt + ppent + aco + intan + ao- ap- lco- lo) / at. Accruals are ( rect-l12.rect + invt - l12.invt + aco - l12.aco - (ap - l12.ap + lco - l12.lco) - dp ) / ((at + l12.at)/2)
